test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can substitute the bracketed word segment meaningfully.

If you behave well and exhibit good manners, then (people will be likely to remember you) in a positive way.

options.text: people are likely to remember you

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct substitution should ensure that the sentence is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 4 contain grammatical errors or do not make sense in the context.
 
• **Option 3, "people are likely to remember you," is grammatically correct and fits well within the sentence.**
 
• Therefore, the correct choice is Option 3.

**Correct Sentence:** ***"If you behave well and exhibit good manners, then people are likely to remember you __in a positive way."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "people likely you remember"** – This option has incorrect word order and is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 2: "people will like in remember"** – This option is not coherent and does not make sense in the context.
 
• **Option 4: "people are like remember you"** – This option is also grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 5:** – Not provided, thus irrelevant in this context.
